newsitem.title: USA: Halter Marine wins contract for 2 barges.
newsitem.headline: Halter Marine wins contract for 2 barges.

text.p: Halter Marine Group Inc said it has been awarded a contract from Trailer Bridge Inc for construction of two, 408 foot Triple Stack Box Carrier barges. Each is configured to carry 53-foot containers.
Trailer Bridge provides truckload service to and from all points in the lower 48 states and Puerto Rico, Halter noted.
The system uses its trucks, drivers, trailers, vessels and marine facilities in Jacksonville, Fla., and San Juan, Puerto Rico.

Halter said construction has begun at its Gulf Coast Fabrication Inc shipyard in Pearlington, Miss. The first vessel will be delivered in late 1997, and the second barge will follow two months later in early 1998.
Last year, Halter Gulf Repair Inc, a Halter shipyard in New Orleans, increased the capacity of two vessels used by Trailer Bridge through the insertion of mid-bodies.
